snippet.title: Robo Miner Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
This is a small new video of the current Robo Miner Gameplay as it is seen on Android Devices. It does not show all Gameplay Elements.

This video was made because Robo Miner was submitted to Steam Greenlight for voting and Users complained about bad video quality :-) (the old vid was very choppy)

I also removed the music (selfmade) because youtube had copyright issues (it was selfmade....)
